_comment: Editable rules mapping Venmo statement titles to filename summaries. Every statement this app lists is titled 'Venmo Statement <YYYY-MM>' by venmo_site.py, so it is filed as '<month end> Venmo Statement.pdf', or 'Venmo Balance Statement <YYYY-MM>' for the Balance tab of a statement with tabs, filed as '<month end> Venmo Balance Statement.pdf'. Each is the month's statement page printed to PDF, and the CSV is never taken.
